The token budget arithmetic ensures that each 10-second clip is represented with 2,688 tokens, enabling contextual reasoning within bounded memory. Joint training on SoccerChat and XFoul datasets outperforms sequential fine-tuning because it avoids catastrophic forgetting and leverages shared latent representations. The use of LLM-as-judge scoring introduces a scalable but potentially biased evaluation mechanism, which limits interpretability. The anonymization of jersey colors promotes generalization by removing identity-specific features. These primitives form a dual framework: one for perception (tokenization, RoPE) and one for reasoning (LLM, QA taxonomy). Failure modes include token overflow, poor ASR quality, and overreliance on automated scoring.
